primitives.note: Undertow's physical damage lands on the axe's travel/impact; Reckless Swing's true damage lands on cast (after its variable cast time), both on cooldown.
Undertow inflicts 20% armor reduction on champions hit for 4s, increasing damage taken from all sources.
Undertow's cooldown can be cut toward a 2.5s floor by retrieving the thrown axe; Reckless Swing's cooldown is refunded 1s per basic attack (2s vs monsters, not relevant here).
Tough It Out grants bonus attack speed for 5s; Ragnarok grants bonus AD (flat + %AD) for a base 3s, extendable.
Tough It Out resets Olaf's basic attack timer on cast.
Berserker Rage grants bonus attack speed scaling with Olaf's missing health up to a level-based cap; Reckless Swing's cast time itself shrinks with bonus attack speed down to a floor.
Reckless Swing costs health (scaling with rank and AD) rather than mana, capped so it cannot drop Olaf below 1 HP.
Q/W/R cost mana (50-70/50/100) and E costs health; in a 15s fight these budgets can cap how many casts are affordable depending on mana pool/regen and current HP.
Berserker Rage's lifesteal, Tough It Out's shield, and Ragnarok's bonus resistances/cc-immunity affect damage taken/survival, not damage dealt in the damage fight.

needsBespoke.why: Berserker Rage's attack speed/lifesteal and Tough It Out's shield both scale continuously with Olaf's own current missing health (not target state, not stacks accumulated from casts/attacks, not a level-gated on/off switch). No primitive in the closed list expresses a self-buff/shield magnitude that is a live function of the caster's own missing-health percentage; this needs bespoke handling to evaluate correctly during the fight (especially since Reckless Swing's self-damage can move Olaf's missing-health % mid-fight and change Passive's live attack speed).

unsettled.question: What is the correct formula/cap for Berserker Rage's missing-health-to-buff conversion: the bin's AttackSpeedPerMissingHPPerc=0.009/MaxStatsThreshold=0.3, or the wiki's stated '1% per 0.7% missing health, capped at 70% missing health' plus its by-level max AS/lifesteal formula?
options: Use the wiki's explicit ratio (1% buff per 0.7% missing HP, full effect at 70% missing HP) scaled to the by-level max values
Use the bin's raw AttackSpeedPerMissingHPPerc=0.009 literally (which does not obviously match either the ratio or the by-level max)
Treat the bin field as an internal/legacy artifact and trust the wiki formula entirely
quotes: 1% per 0.7% '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 70% '''missing''' health.''

unsettled.question: Is Ragnarok's duration extension from on-hit attacks/Reckless Swing casts against a champion uncapped (each hit adds up to 2.5s, potentially keeping the buff active for most/all of the 15s fight against a stationary dummy target), or is there an unstated cap on total extended duration?
options: Uncapped: continuous attacking/casting on the dummy can keep Ragnarok's AD buff active for the whole 15s fight
Each hit's extension diminishes or the total duration is capped at some maximum not stated in either source
Only the first extension per cast of Reckless Swing counts; basic attacks alone cannot indefinitely extend it

proposal: Open by casting Undertow (Q) on the dummy at range to land the physical damage and apply the 20% armor shred immediately, maximizing its 4s uptime overlap with the rest of the burst.
Immediately cast Tough It Out (W) to gain bonus attack speed for 5s and reset the basic attack timer, then start auto-attacking.
Cast Ragnarok (R) as soon as possible after engaging so its bonus AD buff (and duration-extension mechanic from continued attacks/E casts) covers as much of the 15s window as possible.
Cast Reckless Swing (E) on cooldown for its true damage, weaving basic attacks between casts so its cooldown keeps refunding via the 1s-per-attack reduction.
Continue auto-attacking throughout to sustain Ragnarok's duration extension and Reckless Swing's cooldown refund, while accepting the self-inflicted health cost from Reckless Swing.
Recast Undertow again once its cooldown is up (~9s in, faster if axe-retrieval cooldown reduction is modeled) to refresh the armor shred and add another instance of physical damage.
Recast Tough It Out again near its ~12-16s cooldown if the fight extends, to refresh attack speed and re-trigger the attack reset.
questions: Should Ragnarok be cast at the very start of the fight (to maximize AD-buff uptime via the extension mechanic) even though it also costs 100 mana that competes with Q/W's mana budget across only 15s?

Can Undertow's axe-retrieval cooldown reduction be modeled at all in a stationary-dummy damage fight, given it normally requires Olaf to walk back to the landed axe (a positional assumption a dummy fight may not support)?

Given Reckless Swing's cast time shrinks with bonus attack speed, should the rotation prioritize stacking attack speed (via W and gear) before spamming E, or is the cast-time difference negligible enough to ignore for sequencing?

Since a target dummy never fights back, does Berserker Rage's attack-speed/lifesteal scaling ever activate meaningfully in the damage fight, or does it only matter via Olaf's own health loss from casting Reckless Swing?
